families.what_it_does: Cuts away from the speaker to captured app/software footage demonstrating a feature step by step.

families.family: Dominant kinetic title text synced to speech
families.what_it_does: Oversized or animated text fills the frame, timed to slam in or move in sync with spoken phrases.
Closes the video with a stylized platform splash/loading screen or standardized branding card pointing to the profile/handle.
A number rapidly ticks or counts upward on screen to dramatize scale, cost, or success.
A colored box, circle, or animated cursor directs viewer attention to a specific UI element being tapped.
A fast rotational or motion-blurred camera move disguises a cut to a new angle or location.
Cuts to non-UI footage of people/settings to visually ground or support a spoken claim.
silent_names: Mood b-roll cutaway illustrating a claim

families.what_it_does: A bright full-screen flash is used as a hard-cut transition or pattern interrupt.
Individual words within a caption receive distinct typographic treatment to visually underline them.
A branded icon or logo animates in beside the speaker or on screen, paired with a sound cue, to anchor a brand/feature mention.
Cuts back to the presenter, often at a new angle or shot size, to re-anchor after a detour or mark a structural beat.
silent_names: Cut back to talking head (re-anchor after detour)

families.what_it_does: The speaker holds/interacts with a phone as tangible proof for a claim.
Two pieces of footage are mirrored/split side-by-side to let viewers compare states.
silent_names: duplicate/split mirrored panel of the same footage

families.what_it_does: An animated search-bar or address-bar graphic types out text to instruct viewers where to go.
Shows loading bars, checkmarks, or sped-through progress states to signal the software completing a task.
The speaker breaks the fourth wall or points directly at camera to underline a statement.
silent_names: wide static shot with direct-address pointing gesture

families.what_it_does: A rendered 3D icon (lock, laptop) animates to illustrate a concept.
Multiple UI or object graphics float on screen with numeric/dollar labels to imply data or value.
Floating pins or profile graphics represent a pool of people or locations to suggest scale/reach.
A small emoji or stat graphic overlays the frame to punctuate a point.
A tilted polaroid-style frame builds in to reveal a photo or graphic.
A sequence of very fast punch-in zoom cuts keeps energy high during a take.
The talking head shrinks into a corner window beside looping b-roll running simultaneously.
Short caption cards step through feature-by-feature narration over a screen recording, replacing voiceover.
silent_names: Discrete caption cards narrating a demo without voiceover

families.what_it_does: Camera frames the action from behind/over the shoulder to simulate a first-person viewpoint.
silent_names: over-the-shoulder framing on a real edit session

families.what_it_does: A whoosh or pop sound effect accompanies the appearance of a graphic or text element.
The frame goes fully to bold typography or logo, isolating a claim or chapter marker with no speaker visible.
A click or typing sound effect is layered onto an on-screen tap or keyboard action.
Specific words within a caption line render in contrasting color to flag key terms.
silent_names: Colored keyword highlight within running captions

families.what_it_does: Captions accumulate phrase by phrase over an unbroken shot until a full sentence is legible.
silent_names: Word-by-word caption build assembling one full sentence

families.what_it_does: A rendered 3D or tilted perspective gallery/carousel scrolls to imply abundance of options.
An abrupt cut changes room, angle, or lighting to reset visual energy.
silent_names: Hard cut to new location (resets energy)

families.what_it_does: A logo subtly animates while otherwise static to keep an end-card or brand moment alive.
A name, title, or small photo builds in near the speaker to establish identity without cutting away.
Shows the speaker physically acting out an emotional state to dramatize a problem.

families.family: Icon pop-in illustrating spoken feature list
families.what_it_does: A small icon appears beside a caption or joins a growing row to itemize a feature list.
silent_names: Icon pop-in illustrating spoken word/feature list

families.what_it_does: Frequent small zoom punch-ins keep a single continuous take visually active.
A hand-drawn style circular scribble animates onto the frame.
A card with contact information slides into frame.
A single continuous tracking shot from a high angle follows the subject.

families.family: descriptive caption card under the screenshot
families.what_it_does: A caption card sits beneath a screenshot describing it.
silent_names: descriptive caption card under the screenshot

families.what_it_does: Captions shrink in size to shift into a more instructional register.

families.family: extreme close-up on eye, direct address
families.what_it_does: An extreme close-up on the eye with shallow focus creates an intimate direct-address moment.
silent_names: extreme close-up on eye, very shallow focus, direct address

families.what_it_does: A low-angle handheld close-up shot with no captions.
silent_names: extreme low-angle handheld close-up, no captions

families.what_it_does: A finished vertical clip with styled captions plays inside a framed inset preview.
silent_names: finished vertical clip preview with styled highlighted captions playing inside a framed inset

families.what_it_does: A title persists on screen through a location-change cut.
silent_names: hold across cut (title persists through location change)

families.family: italic serif caption card over blurred zoom footage
families.what_it_does: An italic serif caption card overlays blurred zoomed footage.
silent_names: italic serif caption card over blurred zoom footage

families.what_it_does: A greeting text swipes onto the screen kinetically.
The subject walks into frame revealing a new location.
The speaker walks outdoors while text overlays appear.
A single oversized word caption drops in with a colored punctuation dot.
silent_names: oversized single-word caption drop ('cheating') with colored punctuation dot

families.what_it_does: A large stat numeral animates onto the screen.
A pause-icon graphic wipes across the frame as a transition.
A whip motion is used to swap between photos.
A physical prop morphs into a 3D icon graphic.

families.family: quote-mark emphasis on a single word
families.what_it_does: Quote marks emphasize a single word on screen.
silent_names: quote-mark emphasis on a single word

families.what_it_does: A location or prop reappears across the video as a callback.

families.family: slow push/reveal as subject leans back
families.what_it_does: A slow camera push reveals more of the frame as the subject leans back.
silent_names: slow push/reveal as subject leans back

families.what_it_does: Small reaction icons (emoji-like) appear on screen.
UI scrolling is sped up to show rapid browsing.
A vertical line wipes across the frame as a transition.
B-roll footage shows someone walking through a door.

families.family: white-flash whip transition into app splash logos
families.what_it_does: A white-flash whip transitions into a black screen showing app splash logos (CapCut, TikTok).
silent_names: white-flash whip transition into black screen with app splash logos (CapCut, then TikTok)

families.what_it_does: Color desaturates around a spotlighted subject or element.
Audio from the next scene begins before its visual cut, bridging shots.
A UI overlay is shown as captured through a phone camera view.
